extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.17.2 - For BingeTV: it tells you when a newer BingeTV is out (about once a week, or Settings > Expert > Check for BingeTV updates) and offers the download for your device; its first start offers to restore a Kodi backup. Nothing changes elsewhere. v0.17.1 - Settings, a tab per area: Home page layout (BingeTV), Add-ons and manifests, Playback, Subtitles, Watch state, MDBList, IPTV (IPTV Simple's playlist and guide, Dispatcharr Bridge), Search, Expert, Kodi add-ons; with links to Kodi's own player, subtitle and add-on pages. Your settings carry over.
